public.text: The section recommends an interoperability test bed but cites a general European test-bed repository rather than a clearly identified health-specific implementation package.
public.suggestedRevision: Provide health-specific examples and clarify which test-bed capabilities are required for FHIR, IHE, terminology, security, performance, and national profiles.
